en: A black and white postcard image depicting a scenic rural landscape with a modern bridge crossing over a river, surrounded by lush greenery and rolling hills in the background. In the foreground is an open field with haystacks. The text identifies the location as Sundsvall and specifically the 'Kävstabron över Indalsälven,' which is the Kävsta Bridge over the Indal River.
